items.source: The prefix spring.ai.postgresml.embedding is property prefix that configures the EmbeddingModel implementation for PostgresML embeddings.
items.translation: 前缀 `spring.ai.postgresml.embedding` 是用于配置 PostgresML 嵌入的 `EmbeddingModel` 实现的属性前缀。

items.source: PostgresML vector type to use for the embedding. Two options are supported: PG_ARRAY and PG_VECTOR.
items.translation: 用于嵌入的 PostgresML 向量类型。支持两种选项：PG_ARRAY 和 PG_VECTOR。

items.source: Use the PostgresMlEmbeddingOptions.java to configure the PostgresMlEmbeddingModel with options, such as the model to use and etc.
items.translation: 使用PostgresMlEmbeddingOptions.java来配置PostgresMlEmbeddingModel，并设置诸如使用的模型等选项。

items.source: On start you can pass a PostgresMlEmbeddingOptions to the PostgresMlEmbeddingModel constructor to configure the default options used for all embedding requests.
items.translation: 启动时，您可以向 `PostgresMlEmbeddingModel` 构造函数传递一个 `PostgresMlEmbeddingOptions`，以配置所有嵌入请求使用的默认选项。

items.source: At run-time you can override the default options, using a PostgresMlEmbeddingOptions in your EmbeddingRequest.
items.translation: 在运行时，您可以在EmbeddingRequest中使用PostgresMlEmbeddingOptions覆盖默认选项。

items.source: Many pre-trained LLMs can be used to generate embeddings from text within PostgresML. You can browse all the models available to find the best solution on Hugging Face.

items.source: Spring AI supports the PostgresML text embeddings models.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持 PostgresML 文本嵌入模型。

items.source:
Embeddings are a numeric representation of text.
They are used to represent words and sentences as vectors, an array of numbers.
Embeddings can be used to find similar pieces of text, by comparing the similarity of the numeric vectors using a distance measure, or they can be used as input features for other machine learning models, since most algorithms can’t use text directly.
items.translation: 嵌入是文本的数值表示。它们将单词和句子表示为向量，即一组数字。嵌入可用于查找相似的文本片段，通过比较数值向量之间的距离度量来评估其相似性；或者，由于大多数算法无法直接使用文本，嵌入也可作为其他机器学习模型的输入特征。

items.source: To enable, spring.ai.model.embedding=postgresml (It is enabled by default)
items.translation: 要启用该功能，请设置 spring.ai.model.embedding=postgresml（默认已启用）。

items.source: To disable, spring.ai.model.embedding=none (or any value which doesn’t match postgresml)
items.translation: 要禁用该功能，请将 spring.ai.model.embedding 设置为 none（或任何不等于 postgresml 的值）。

items.source: This change is done to allow configuration of multiple models.
items.translation: 此更改旨在支持配置多个模型。
